hook.text: Why would you plant a tree if someone can take the fruit? Property rights make long-term investment rational.

buildup.text: Without clear ownership, people grab resources now instead of investing for later. Cooperation collapses.

discovery.text: Hernando de Soto showed that billions of dollars in assets sit 'dead' because the poor lack formal property titles.

twist.text: Property rights aren't just about things. Patents, copyrights, and spectrum rights create trust in ideas too.

climax.text: Countries with strong property rights attract more investment. Secure ownership is the foundation of markets.

punchline.text: Own it clearly, invest in it boldly.

quiz.question: Why do property rights encourage cooperation?
options: They allow long-term investment by securing ownership
